sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.26 "TIM timer input selection register (TIM_TISEL)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1109.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x05C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:24 TI4SEL[3:0]: Selects tim_ti4[15:0] input
0000: tim_ti4_in0: TIM_CH4
0001: tim_ti4_in1
...
1111: tim_ti4_in15
Refer to Section31.3.2: TIM1/TIM8 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
Bits 23:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:16 TI3SEL[3:0]: Selects tim_ti3[15:0] input
0000: tim_ti3_in0: TIM_CH2
0001: tim_ti3_in1
...
1111: tim_ti3_in15
Refer to Section31.3.2: TIM1/TIM8 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:8 TI2SEL[3:0]: Selects tim_ti2[15:0] input
0000: tim_ti2_in0: TIM_CH2
0001: tim_ti2_in1
...
1111: tim_ti2_in15
Refer to Section31.3.2: TIM1/TIM8 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
Bits 7:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 3:0 TI1SEL[3:0]: Selects tim_ti1[15:0] input
0000: tim_ti1_in0: TIM_CH1
0001: tim_ti1_in1
...
1111: tim_ti1_in15
Refer to Section31.3.2: TIM1/TIM8 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
